questions.en: Which Spanish conqueror brought cacao to Europe in 1528?

timeline.labelEn: Hernán Cortés brings cacao from Mexico to Europe
timeline.labelDe: Hernán Cortés bringt den Kakao aus Mexiko nach Europa

questions.notes: True/false reworked. The card's statement is false for Europe: cacao only reached Europe in the 16th century (Cortés, 1528), after the Middle Ages; chocolate was later sold in pharmacies as a tonic (early 19th century).

timeline.labelEn: Western publishers exhibit at the Leipzig Book Fair in the GDR for the first time
timeline.labelDe: Westliche Verlage stellen erstmals auf der Leipziger Buchmesse in der DDR aus

questions.notes: True/false reworked; the statement is false — Western publishers attended from 1952 and the fair was a meeting point for East and West. Wikipedia says 'westliche Verlage' rather than naming West German firms specifically.

timeline.labelDe: Tim Peake läuft den London-Marathon auf einem Laufband an Bord der ISS
